evals.prompt: Set up GitHub Actions to deploy my Trigger.dev tasks. I have a self-hosted instance and want to deploy to staging on develop branch pushes and production on main branch pushes.
evals.expected_output: Should show GitHub Actions YAML with branch conditions, TRIGGER_ACCESS_TOKEN and TRIGGER_API_URL secrets, deploy --env staging/prod with the CLI pinned to the SDK/server version
expectations: Has branch conditions for staging and production
Pins the trigger.dev CLI to the SDK/server version instead of @latest
Uses --env prod (not production) for the production deploy
